research.title: No Crash Required: Verifying the Citrix NetScaler SAML Patch for CVE-2026-8452
research.summary: CVE-2026-8452 lets an unauthenticated attacker corrupt memory in Citrix NetScaler's SAML parser with a single request, potentially leading to remote code execution. Bishop Fox breaks down the patch, how to safely verify it across a fleet, and what.

research.title: CVE-2026-19478 | MeGitLab CE/EE GraphQL Directive Code Injection Vulnerability
research.summary: CVE-2026-19478 is a critical code injection vulnerability in GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE). Under certain conditions, an unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a GraphQL directive to modify or delete public projects and user.

research.title: Is Cyber missing the Marque?

research.title: CVE-2026-69414 ShieldBreak Zero-Day: No Patch, and CISA BOD 26-04 Gives You 14 Days
research.summary: Executive Summary ShieldBreak (CVE-2026-69414) is a zero-day elevation-of-privilege vulnerability in the Microsoft Malware Protection Engine used by Microsoft Defender, allowing a low-privilege local attacker to escalate to SYSTEM. A public PoC was released.

research.title: CTEM 101: Moving From Spreadsheets to Continuous Risk Reduction
research.summary: Traditional vulnerability management was built for a smaller, slower problem than most teams face today. This post breaks down CTEM, why it exists, how its five stages work, and what it actually takes to move from a reactive pile of findings to a continuous,.

research.title: Integrate Aqua and Datadog to Connect Runtime Security with Application Performance
research.summary: TL;DR AI is compressing the time between vulnerability discovery and exploitation, while security teams still depend on workflows that require people to review alerts and piece together context. A vulnerable or unauthorized image, a runtime policy violation.

research.title: UAT-10147 deploys SPECTRE: A cross-platform implant with Linux rootkit and BYOVD capabilities
research.summary: UAT-10147 is a highly capable Chinese-speaking intrusion actor operating a multi-platform post-exploitation ecosystem targeting IIS and Linux servers, combining search engine optimization (SEO) fraud monetization with advanced persistence and defense evasion.

research.title: UAT-10147: Chinese-speaking adversary integrates agentic AI into post-compromise operations
research.summary: Cisco Talos identified UAT-10147 targeting Windows and Linux web servers globally, impacting organizations in government, education, media, technology, and gaming sectors. The actor leveraged publicly disclosed vulnerabilities to gain initial access at.

research.title: Identity Abuse Through Trusted Communication Channels
research.summary: Unit 42 details how attackers exploit enterprise collaboration tools for identity phishing and credential theft. Discover key defense strategies. The post Identity Abuse Through Trusted Communication Channels appeared first on Unit 42 .

research.title: Building Capacity and Resilience for U.S. Partners
research.summary: Nation-state actors and cybercriminals are using AI to find weaknesses, accelerate attacks, and exploit interconnected environments. Defending against them requires more than securing individual organizations. It means strengthening resilience across the.

research.title: CTEM: From Visibility to Measurable Risk Reduction
research.summary: Visibility alone does not reduce risk. Security teams have more exposure data than ever, but still struggle to answer the questions that matter: What can an attacker actually exploit? Which exposures create meaningful business risk? And did remediation.
